title: Ascending chain condition for quasi-coherent submodules on a Noetherian scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] with quasi-compact underlying space) and $\mathcal F$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Every increasing sequence $\mathcal F_1\subseteq\mathcal F_2\subseteq\dots\subseteq\mathcal F$ of quasi-coherent submodules is eventually constant. In particular ($\mathcal F=\mathcal O_X$) every nonempty set of quasi-coherent sheaves of ideals of $\mathcal O_X$ has a maximal element for inclusion.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01Y8 (lemma-acc-coherent); the maximal-element form is how the proofs of Proposition 088C and Theorem 088E use it
